prior_observational_study.population: ALL 6 HORIZONS POOLED (T0, T30, T60, T120, T180, T300) in 2024 (N=61,537 rows)

reconciliation_verdict.explanation: The jump in catastrophic capture from 18.34% to 67.51% is NOT due to a denominator definition difference. Both used captured_cat / total_cat. The jump is directly caused by future lookahead leakage in `scripts/run_delayed_entry_policy_study.py`. Specifically, `magnitude_new_incumbent_extreme_post_entry` incorporated `cur_peak`, which had been iterated to the end of the multi-hour regime (idx_reg_end). When recomputed on the exact same P0 rows using strictly causal features available at +30s, the catastrophic capture is 17.80%, perfectly reconciling with the prior observational study's 18.34%.
